The '''Fission Chamber''' was an [[Engine/Legends|engine]] component utilized by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. A fission reaction was achieved by catalysts reacting in the chamber with the output of the [[Power converter/Legends|power converter]]. This produced tremendous thrust that translated into high [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] speeds.<ref name="SWS" />
